title: Fix OAuth PKCE and Token Exchange Tests
description: Fix the 2 failing tests in tests/auth/oauth.test.ts by implementing correct RFC 7636 challenge string calculation and adding the missing access_token test for exchangeCodeForToken.
acceptance_criteria: RFC 7636 PKCE challenge calculation test passes.
exchangeCodeForToken correctly handles and tests access_token.

implementation_notes: Use crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256') and base64url encoding for PKCE.
test_scenarios: Calculates correct challenge string for a given code verifier.

title: Author Anti-Sybil Tests
description: Author tests/auth/sybil.test.ts to verify the 5-layer anti-sybil checks.
acceptance_criteria: Tests cover all 5 layers of anti-sybil protection.
Tests successfully mock/simulate bot and legitimate user behaviors.

implementation_notes: Include checks for account age, Turnstile siteverify, rate limiting, IP reputation, etc.

title: Implement Demo Durable Object
description: Implement src/auth/demo_do.ts and tests/auth/demo_do.test.ts based on the DemoDO design in docs/system_design_v3.md.
acceptance_criteria: DemoDO implements 15-minute token rotation using DO Alarms.
Handles IP sliding windows for rate-limiting.
Tests in demo_do.test.ts pass and cover token rotation and expiration.

exact_signatures: export class DemoDO implements DurableObject { constructor(private readonly ctx: DurableObjectStateLike) {} public async alarm(): Promise<void>; public async getActiveDemoToken(): Promise<{ token: string; expiresAt: number }>; }
implementation_notes: Use this.ctx.storage.setAlarm for scheduling the 15-minute rotation.
test_scenarios: Token rotates after alarm is triggered.
Expired IP rate limit data is pruned.
